question: How many patients are in the dataset?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_patients;
gold_answer: The total count of patients in the population.

question: What is the gender distribution of patients?
gold_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_patients GROUP BY gender ORDER BY n DESC;
gold_answer: Patient counts broken down by gender (typically a roughly even male/female split).

question: What are the 10 most frequently recorded conditions?
gold_sql: SELECT description, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_conditions GROUP BY description ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: The ten condition descriptions with the highest record counts.

question: What is the average total claim cost per encounter, by encounter class?
gold_sql: SELECT encounterclass, ROUND(AVG(total_claim_cost)::numeric, 2) AS avg_cost FROM v_encounters GROUP BY encounterclass ORDER BY avg_cost DESC;
gold_answer: Average total claim cost grouped by encounter class, highest to lowest (inpatient is usually the most expensive class).

question: What are the top 10 most prescribed medications by number of prescriptions?
gold_sql: SELECT description, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_medications GROUP BY description ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: The ten medication descriptions with the most prescription records.

question: Which payers covered the largest share of total claim cost across all encounters? Show the top 5.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(e.payer_coverage)::numeric, 2) AS covered FROM v_encounters e JOIN v_payers p ON e.payer = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY covered DESC LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: The five payers with the highest summed payer_coverage across encounters.

question: How many emergency department visits occurred per 1,000 patients?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'emergency')::numeric * 1000 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_patients), 1) AS ed_visits_per_1000;
gold_answer: Emergency encounters normalized to a rate per 1,000 patients.

question: What is the average age of patients who have a Type 2 diabetes diagnosis?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(pt.age)::numeric, 1) AS avg_age FROM v_patients pt WHERE pt.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient FROM v_conditions WHERE code = '44054006');
gold_answer: Mean (90-capped) age of the cohort with a Type 2 diabetes condition (SNOMED 44054006).

question: What percentage of patients have received at least one immunization?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient) FROM v_immunizations)::numeric * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_patients), 1) AS pct_immunized;
gold_answer: Share of the patient population with one or more immunization records.

question: What is the average total cost of care per patient, based on total claim cost across encounters?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(pt_cost)::numeric, 2) AS avg_cost_per_patient FROM (SELECT patient, SUM(total_claim_cost) AS pt_cost FROM v_encounters GROUP BY patient) s;
gold_answer: Per-patient total claim cost, averaged across the population.

question: What is the 30-day all-cause inpatient readmission rate?
gold_sql: WITH inp AS (SELECT patient, start_shifted, stop_shifted, LEAD(start_shifted) OVER (PARTITION BY patient ORDER BY start_shifted) AS next_start FROM v_encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'inpatient') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE next_start IS NOT NULL AND next_start <= stop_shifted + INTERVAL '30 days') / COUNT(*), 1) AS readmit_rate_30d FROM inp;
gold_answer: Percentage of inpatient stays followed by another inpatient admission for the same patient within 30 days.

question: What is the average inpatient length of stay in days?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(los_days)::numeric, 2) AS avg_los_days FROM v_encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'inpatient';
gold_answer: Mean length of stay (days) for inpatient encounters.

question: What are the 10 most common procedures by volume?
gold_sql: SELECT description, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_procedures GROUP BY description ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10;
gold_answer: The ten procedure descriptions performed most often.

question: Among patients with Type 2 diabetes, what percentage have at least one Hemoglobin A1c observation?
gold_sql: WITH dm AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient FROM v_conditions WHERE code = '44054006') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.patient) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm), 1) AS pct_with_a1c FROM v_observations o JOIN dm ON o.patient = dm.patient WHERE o.code = '4548-4';
gold_answer: HEDIS-style measure: share of the Type 2 diabetes cohort (SNOMED 44054006) with at least one A1c result (LOINC 4548-4).

question: How many distinct patients are associated with each payer? Show the top 5.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.patient) AS patients FROM v_encounters e JOIN v_payers p ON e.payer = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY patients DESC LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: The five payers linked to the most distinct patients (a covered-lives proxy).

question: What percentage of encounters had no insurance coverage (payer coverage of zero)?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payer_coverage = 0) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_uncovered FROM v_encounters;
gold_answer: Share of encounters where payer_coverage is zero (uninsured/self-pay proxy).

question: What is the distribution of patients by race?
gold_sql: SELECT race, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_patients GROUP BY race ORDER BY n DESC;
gold_answer: Patient counts by race category, most to least common.

question: How many encounters occurred each year? Show by encounter year, ascending.
gold_sql: SELECT encounter_year, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_encounters GROUP BY encounter_year ORDER BY encounter_year;
gold_answer: Encounter volume per (shifted) calendar year, oldest first.

question: What are the top 5 conditions among patients aged 65 and older?
gold_sql: SELECT c.description, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_conditions c JOIN v_patients p ON c.patient = p.id WHERE p.age >= 65 GROUP BY c.description ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: The five most frequent conditions in the 65+ cohort.

question: What percentage of patients are on 5 or more distinct medications (polypharmacy)?
gold_sql: WITH pm AS (SELECT patient, COUNT(DISTINCT code) AS n_meds FROM v_medications GROUP BY patient) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_meds >= 5) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_patients), 1) AS pct_polypharmacy FROM pm;
gold_answer: Share of all patients with five or more distinct medications (polypharmacy prevalence).

question: What is the total claim cost across all encounters, by encounter year?
gold_sql: SELECT encounter_year, ROUND(SUM(total_claim_cost)::numeric,2) AS total FROM v_encounters GROUP BY encounter_year ORDER BY encounter_year;
gold_answer: Total claim cost summed per (shifted) year.

question: What is the average base encounter cost by encounter class?
gold_sql: SELECT encounterclass, ROUND(AVG(base_encounter_cost)::numeric,2) AS avg_base FROM v_encounters GROUP BY encounterclass ORDER BY avg_base DESC;
gold_answer: Average base encounter cost per class, highest first.

question: Overall, what percentage of total claim cost was covered by payers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((100.0*SUM(payer_coverage)/NULLIF(SUM(total_claim_cost),0))::numeric,1) AS pct_covered FROM v_encounters;
gold_answer: Share of total claim cost paid by payers (coverage ratio).

question: What is the average lifetime healthcare expense per patient?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(healthcare_expenses)::numeric,2) AS avg_expenses FROM v_patients;
gold_answer: Mean of patients' recorded healthcare_expenses.

question: What are the 5 procedures with the highest total cost?
gold_sql: SELECT description, ROUND(SUM(base_cost)::numeric,2) AS total FROM v_procedures GROUP BY description ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: Top 5 procedure descriptions by summed base_cost.

question: What is the average number of encounters per patient?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric/COUNT(DISTINCT patient),2) AS enc_per_patient FROM v_encounters;
gold_answer: Encounters divided by distinct patients.

question: How many wellness visits were there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_encounters WHERE encounterclass='wellness';
gold_answer: Count of wellness-class encounters.

question: How many inpatient encounters occurred per 1,000 patients?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_encounters WHERE encounterclass='inpatient')::numeric*1000/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_patients),1) AS inpatient_per_1000;
gold_answer: Inpatient encounters normalized per 1,000 patients.

question: How many distinct patients have at least one procedure?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient) AS n FROM v_procedures;
gold_answer: Distinct patients appearing in procedures.

question: What is the average number of procedures per patient?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric/COUNT(DISTINCT patient),2) AS proc_per_patient FROM v_procedures;
gold_answer: Procedures divided by distinct patients.

question: How many distinct condition types are recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT code) AS n FROM v_conditions;
gold_answer: Count of distinct condition codes.

question: What are the top 5 conditions among patients under 18?
gold_sql: SELECT c.description, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_conditions c JOIN v_patients p ON c.patient=p.id WHERE p.age<18 GROUP BY c.description ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: Most frequent conditions in the pediatric cohort.

question: What percentage of patients are deceased?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deceased)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct_deceased FROM v_patients;
gold_answer: Share of patients flagged deceased.

question: What is the average age of patients with hypertension?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(age)::numeric,1) AS avg_age FROM v_patients WHERE id IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient FROM v_conditions WHERE code='59621000');
gold_answer: Mean age of the hypertension (SNOMED 59621000) cohort.

question: How many distinct patients have had an emergency visit?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient) AS n FROM v_encounters WHERE encounterclass='emergency';
gold_answer: Distinct patients with at least one ED encounter.

question: What is the average number of distinct medications per patient?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt)::numeric,2) AS avg_distinct_meds FROM (SELECT patient, COUNT(DISTINCT code) AS cnt FROM v_medications GROUP BY patient) s;
gold_answer: Mean distinct medication count per patient.

question: What is the total number of medication dispenses?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(dispenses) AS total_dispenses FROM v_medications;
gold_answer: Sum of the dispenses column across medications.

question: What are the top 5 medications by total cost?
gold_sql: SELECT description, ROUND(SUM(totalcost)::numeric,2) AS total FROM v_medications GROUP BY description ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
gold_answer: Top 5 medication descriptions by summed totalcost.

question: What percentage of patients are on at least one medication?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT patient)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_patients),1) AS pct FROM v_medications;
gold_answer: Share of patients with any medication record.

question: What is the average payer coverage amount for medications?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payer_coverage)::numeric,2) AS avg_cov FROM v_medications;
gold_answer: Mean payer_coverage across medication records.

question: What percentage of encounters are wellness visits?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE encounterclass='wellness')/COUNT(*),1) AS pct_wellness FROM v_encounters;
gold_answer: Share of encounters in the wellness class.

question: What is the average number of observations recorded per patient?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric/COUNT(DISTINCT patient),2) AS obs_per_patient FROM v_observations;
gold_answer: Observations divided by distinct patients.

question: What percentage of patients have at least one recorded observation?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT patient)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_patients),1) AS pct FROM v_observations;
gold_answer: Share of patients with any observation.

question: How many 30-day inpatient readmissions occurred (count, not rate)?
gold_sql: WITH inp AS (SELECT patient, start_shifted, stop_shifted, LEAD(start_shifted) OVER (PARTITION BY patient ORDER BY start_shifted) AS nx FROM v_encounters WHERE encounterclass='inpatient') SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nx IS NOT NULL AND nx <= stop_shifted + INTERVAL '30 days') AS readmissions FROM inp;
gold_answer: Count of inpatient stays followed by another inpatient admission within 30 days.

question: What is the average length of stay for emergency encounters?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(los_days)::numeric,2) AS avg_los FROM v_encounters WHERE encounterclass='emergency';
gold_answer: Mean length of stay for ED encounters.

question: How many encounters are associated with each payer?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_encounters e JOIN v_payers p ON e.payer=p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY n DESC;
gold_answer: Encounter volume by payer name.

question: What percentage of encounters are covered by Medicare?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.name='Medicare')/COUNT(*),1) AS pct_medicare FROM v_encounters e JOIN v_payers p ON e.payer=p.id;
gold_answer: Share of encounters whose payer is Medicare.

question: What is the distribution of patients by marital status?
gold_sql: SELECT marital, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_patients GROUP BY marital ORDER BY n DESC;
gold_answer: Patient counts by marital status.

question: What is the distribution of patients by ethnicity?
gold_sql: SELECT ethnicity, COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_patients GROUP BY ethnicity ORDER BY n DESC;
gold_answer: Patient counts by ethnicity.

question: What is the average member-months across payers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(member_months)::numeric,1) AS avg_member_months FROM v_payers WHERE member_months IS NOT NULL;
gold_answer: Mean member_months over payers reporting it.
